additionalIndependentProbe.method: Reviewer-authored in-memory JavaScript piped through node --import tsx --input-type=module, without creating or changing a test file.
additionalIndependentProbe.purpose: Exercise nonzero pre-existing interactive discard together with retained fractional recording debt. Check every one of 180 controlled steps against an independently constructed contiguous tick sequence, then request a pause inside a controlled callback and verify the following paused call performs no work.
additionalIndependentProbe.interpretation: The 180 requested controlled ticks ended at tick 188; the deliberate pause-boundary callback committed one additional real tick, producing the reported final tick 189. The subsequent call while paused committed zero ticks.

reviewFindings: The runtime uses the new API only when controlledTake and shortTakeActive are both true; FixedClock additionally requires recording mode while running.
Controlled steps neither add nor consume accumulated wall time, neither reset the world nor rewrite accumulated discard, and do not invoke wall-time discard preview or audio epoch shift.
Existing advance(), recording-overrun pause/debt retention, interactive discard, backpressure pause and exact short-take tick guard remain in place.

A failure before the solver completes does not invent a clock tick; a failure after a completed solver tick pauses and commits that completed tick. This is safe-stop behavior, not a claim that every observer fault supports an immediate retry.
limits: No browser, native audio, broad runtime suite, performance profile or 600-second gate was executed by this reviewer for this repair.
The 9 focused tests were independently executed and reviewed; they were authored by the implementation owner. The additional in-memory probe was authored and executed by this reviewer.
Product files, tests and Git were not modified by this reviewer. This evidence file records already completed observations; no tests were repeated to prepare the receipt.
This scoped review is not a full V1 completion claim.
